item.title: 'Non-resident' comprehensive real estate tax deduction to be further eased? Han Byung-do says "will raise the completeness of the tax system" (‘비거주’ 종부세 공제 더 완화하나…한병도 “세제 완성도 높이겠다”)
item.description:
A revised government tax reform proposal was submitted to the National Assembly on the 3rd, maintaining the current basic deduction amount of 1.2 billion won (based on publicly announced prices) for the comprehensive real estate tax (CRET) for non-resident single-homeowners, and restructuring the long-term holding special deduction for capital gains tax around residency. The Democratic Party of Korea evaluated the government's revised proposal as "a reasonable adjustment that clearly establishes a tax system centered on actual residence," while leaving open the possibility of further revisions to details during the parliamentary review process. (비거주 1주택자의 종합부동산세(종부세) 기본공제 금액을 현행 12억원(공시가격 기준)으로 유지하고, 양도소득세 장기보유특별공제를 거주 중심으로 개편하는 정부 세제개편 수정안이 3일 국회에 제출됐다. 더불어민주당은 정부 수정안에 대해 “실거주 중심의 과세 체계를 분명히 한 합리적 조정안”이라고 평가하면서도, 향후 국회 심사 과정에서 세부 내용에 대한 추가 수정 가능성을 열어두고 있다.)

Han Byung-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, said at a policy coordination meeting held at the National Assembly that day regarding the government's revised tax reform proposal, "It is a reasonable outcome arrived at after listening to the opinions of the public and the market and deliberating between the party and the government." The Democratic Party's policy committee also stated in a press notice that "the party and government have clearly established the basic direction of a tax system centered on actual residence, and this is a realistic and reasonable adjustment." However, floor leader Han said, "We will listen to the voices of the people and raise the completeness of the budget and tax system," signaling an intention to further refine the government's revised proposal during the regular session's tax law review. A party policy committee official also told The Hankyoreh that day, "While maintaining the principles of the larger framework, we will discuss details flexibly." (한병도 민주당 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 정책조정회의에서 정부 세제개편 수정안에 대해 “국민과 시장의 의견을 경청하고 당·정이 숙의한 합리적 결과”라고 말했다. 민주당 정책위원회도 언론 공지를 통해 “당·정이 실거주 중심의 과세체계라는 기본 방향을 분명히 한 현실적이고 합리적인 조정안”이라고 평가했다. 다만 한 원내대표는 “국민 목소리에 귀 기울여 예산과 세제의 완성도를 높이겠다”며 향후 정기국회 세법 심사 과정에서 정부 수정안을 추가로 손질할 뜻을 밝혔다. 당 정책위 관계자도 이날 한겨레에 “큰 틀의 원칙은 유지하되, 세부 내용에 대해서는 유연하게 논의할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Within the party, voices are rising, especially among lawmakers with constituencies in Seoul, that the basic deduction amount for the comprehensive real estate tax for non-resident single-homeowners should also be raised to 1.4 billion won, like actual residents. In addition, attention is focused on whether revisions will be made to the capital gains tax reform plan that converts the long-term holding special deduction into a long-term residency income deduction. A lawmaker from the Democratic Party's Housing Market Stabilization Task Force (TF) said that day, "Regarding capital gains tax, there has been no major disagreement within the party over the government's reform proposal from the start," adding, "However, we will closely examine the impact on the market, such as on the supply of jeonse (long-term deposit-based rentals) and monthly rentals." This is interpreted to mean that while the broad direction of 'residency-centered deductions' will be maintained, some details of the plan could be adjusted. (당내에선 서울을 지역구로 하는 의원들을 중심으로 비거주 1주택자의 종부세 기본공제 금액도 실거주자처럼 14억원으로 올려야 한다는 목소리가 잇따르고 있다. 아울러 장기보유특별공제를 장기거주소득공제로 전환하는 양도세제 개편안에 대한 수정이 이뤄질지에도 관심이 쏠린다. 이날 민주당 주택시장안정화 태스크포스(TF) 소속 한 의원은 “양도세에 대해선 정부 개편안에 대해 당내에 애초 큰 이견이 없다”며 “다만 전월세 공급 등 시장에 끼칠 영향은 면밀하게 살펴볼 것”이라고 말했다. ‘거주 중심 공제’란 큰 틀의 방향은 유지하되, 세부안을 일부 손볼 수 있단 뜻으로 해석된다.)

Within the party, there are voices calling for partial amendments and supplementation of the government's plan to 'phase out preferential long-term holding special deductions for registered rental business operators.' That day, the Democratic Party dismissed a media report that 'the ruling party delivered a proposal to postpone the abolition of the long-term holding special deduction to the government,' saying, "Nothing has been delivered to the government." (당내에선 ‘등록임대사업자에 대한 장기보유특별공제 우대 단계적 폐지’ 정부안을 일부 수정·보완하자는 목소리가 나오고 있다. 이날 민주당은 ‘여당이 장특공제 폐지 연기안 등을 정부에 전달했다’는 한 언론 보도에 대해서는 “정부 쪽에 전달한 바 없다”고 일축했다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party also announced that day that it would prepare a 'stock price suppression prevention bill' (amendment to the Inheritance and Gift Tax Act) at the party level. Floor leader Han said, "Based on bills proposed by our party's lawmakers, we will prepare effective measures during the regular session." (한편, 민주당은 이날 여당 차원의 ‘주가 누르기 방지법안’(상속증여세법 개정안)도 마련하겠다고 밝혔다. 한 원내대표는 “우리 당 소속 의원들이 발의한 법안을 토대로 정기국회에서 실효성 있는 방안을 마련하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Holds Tea Meeting with Both Major Labor Federations: "Mega Projects Essential for Strengthening National Competitiveness" (이 대통령, 양대 노총과 차담…“메가 프로젝트, 국가경쟁력 강화 위해 필수”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung met on the 3rd with Kim Dong-myung, Chairman of the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU), and Yang Kyung-soo, Chairman of the Korean Federation of Democratic Trade Unions (KCTU), to hear labor's views on pending issues, including the government's three major mega projects (semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI), and asked for their cooperation. He also requested participation in social dialogue. <<> During the tea meeting with the chairmen of the two major labor federations that day, President Lee emphasized "the national importance of the mega projects and that their successful implementation is essential for strengthening future generations and national competitiveness," according to a written briefing by Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung of the Presidential Office. <<> In response, the chairmen of the two labor federations suggested that close communication and active participation by labor are necessary for the successful implementation of the projects. They also stated their position that pending labor-related issues in the currently debated Mega Special Zone Special Act should be resolved through social dialogue involving both labor and management. Earlier, the government was reported to be pursuing a plan to include provisions in the Mega Special Zone Special Act that would exempt R&D personnel from the 52-hour weekly work-hour cap and extend the permitted employment period for fixed-term workers, among other labor deregulation measures, which sparked backlash from the labor community. <<> The issue of extending the mandatory retirement age was also discussed at the meeting. According to Press Secretary Kang, the chairmen of the two labor federations agreed that the bill on extending the retirement age, which had been discussed over the past year at the National Assembly's Special Committee on Retirement Age Extension, needs to produce results within this year through parliamentary deliberation that reflects diverse interests. <<> President Lee also expressed his welcome for the beginning of discussions within the Korean Federation of Democratic Trade Unions on returning to social dialogue. Press Secretary Kang added that President Lee, noting the many national tasks that labor, management, and government must address together—such as AI transition in the workplace and resolving K-shaped polarization—asked the two major labor federations to find solutions through full-fledged social dialogue with the participation of both. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 3일 김동명 한국노총 위원장, 양경수 민주노총 위원장을 만나 정부가 추진하는 3대 메가 프로젝트(반도체, 인공지능 데이터센터, 피지컬 에이아이) 등 현안에 대한 노동계 의견을 듣고 협조를 당부했다. 사회적 대화 참여도 요청했다.)

item.title: Kim Seung-won and Yong Hye-in controversies spread... Is the cabinet reshuffle effect fading? [Gongdeok Pocha] (김승원·용혜인 의혹 확산…개각 효과 사라지나? [공덕포차])
item.description:
<<>> ()

Controversies surrounding Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, and Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, are spreading. The opposition is launching a full-scale offensive, zeroing in on allegations that Kim had previously sought favors regarding a COVID-19 treatment clinical trial. On the 3rd, the Democratic Party of Korea urged independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who raised the allegations, to "stop raising distorted claims and apologize immediately." ()

Yong's controversy over simultaneously holding both a ministerial post and a parliamentary seat continues, and concerns are growing even within the ruling camp. Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok said of Yong on the same day, "I am listening to the many concerns and criticisms and thinking deeply about them." ( 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자와 용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자를 둘러싼 논란이 확산하고 있습니다. 야권은 김 후보자의 과거 ‘코로나19 치료제 임상시험 청탁 의혹’을 정조준하고 총공세에 나섰습니다. 더불어민주당은 3일 해당 의혹을 제기한 무소속 한동훈 후보를 향해 “사실을 왜곡한 의혹 제기를 중단하고 즉각 사과하라”고 촉구했습니다.)

With the controversies surrounding both nominees, will the effect of the cabinet reshuffle aimed at renewing state affairs fade away? Why did former Cheong Wa Dae policy chief Kim Yong-beom resign just two days after the reshuffle? What is the intention of Cho Kuk, head of the Innovation Policy Research Institute of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, who has been clashing with the government daily through social media? Tune in to YouTube Hankyoreh TV at 7:45 PM on the 3rd! ( 용 후보자는 장관직·의원직 겸직 논란이 계속되며 여권에서도 우려가 커지고 있습니다. 김민석 민주당 대표는 이날 용 후보자에 대해 “많은 우려와 비판을 듣고 깊이 생각하고 있다”고 말했습니다.)

item.title: Only the Defense Ministry Left Out of Sejong Move... Is It Because of 'Defending Seoul'? (국방부만 쏙 빠졌네, 세종 이전…‘서울 사수’ 때문일까)
item.description:
Interior and Safety Minister Yoon Ho-jung announced at a press conference on the 'Plan for Relocation of Administrative and Public Institutions and Measures to Reform Public Institution Functions' held at the Seoul Government Complex on the 3rd that the sequential relocation of central administrative agencies in the Seoul metropolitan area, including the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, to Sejong will begin in the first half of 2027. The specific list of institutions to be relocated will be confirmed and announced in the fourth quarter of this year. The government is pushing to amend the law to remove the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family from the list of institutions excluded from relocation, as currently stipulated under the Sejong City Special Act, to enable their move to Sejong. (윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 3일 정부서울청사에서 열린 ‘행정·공공기관 이전 계획 및 공공기관 기능 개혁 방안’ 기자회견에서 2027년 상반기부터 법무부와 성평등가족부 등 수도권 소재 중앙행정기관의 세종 이전을 순차적으로 추진한다고 밝혔다. 구체적인 이전 대상은 올해 4분기 확정·고시한다. 정부는 현행 행복도시법상 이전 제외기관으로 규정된 법무부와 성평등가족부의 세종 이전을 위해 이들 부처를 이전 제외 기관에서 삭제하는 내용의 법 개정을 추진한다.)

According to the Sejong City Special Act on the 4th, the ministries excluded from relocation to Sejong are five: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Unification, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of National Defense, and the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family. With the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family removed, the number of ministries remaining in Seoul will drop to three (Foreign Affairs, Unification, and National Defense). (4일 행복도시법을 보면, 세종 이전 대상에서 제외한 부처는 외교부·통일부·법무부·국방부·성평등가족부 등 5곳이다. 법무부와 성평등가족부가 빠지면 서울에 남는 부처는 3곳(외교부, 통일부, 국방부)으로 줄어든다.)

Minister Yoon said, "For the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the Ministry of Unification, relocation is being considered in line with timing such as 2030, when the president's (Sejong) office moves, or 2033, when the legislative branch's branch office opens." If the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Unification are later removed, the Ministry of National Defense will be the only central government ministry left in Seoul. (윤 장관은 “외교부나 통일부는 대통령 (세종) 집무실이 이전하는 2030년, 또는 입법부 분원이 개원하는 2033년 등 그런 시기에 맞춰서 이전이 검토되고 있다”고 말했다. 앞으로 외교부, 통일부가 빠지면 중앙행정부처 중 국방부만 서울에 남게 된다.)

When the Sejong City Special Act was enacted in 2005, six ministries were excluded from relocation (Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Ministry of Unification, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of National Defense, Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs, and Ministry of Gender Equality). In 2017, the exclusion clause for the Ministry of the Interior and Safety was deleted from the Sejong City Special Act, and in February 2019, that ministry moved to Sejong. The number of excluded institutions, originally six, has now been reduced to five after the Interior Ministry was removed. The 2005 law did not specify the rationale for excluding each ministry. At the time, government officials and the media speculated it was due to national security, crisis response, and diplomatic necessity. (2005년 행복도시법 제정 당시 이전 제외 부처가 6곳(외교통상부·통일부·법무부·국방부·행정자치부·여성부)이었다. 지난 2017년 행복도시법에서 행정안전부 제외 조항이 삭제돼, 지난 2019년 2월 행정안전부가 세종으로 옮겼다. 애초 6곳이던 이전 제외 기관에서 행정안전부가 빠져 현재 5곳으로 줄었다. 지난 2005년 법 제정 당시 부처별 이전 제외 근거를 명시하지 않았다. 당시 공무원 사회와 언론에선 국가안보, 위기 대응, 외교적 필요성 등으로 추정했다.)

The government also did not disclose the reason for excluding the Ministry of National Defense on this day, but many inside and outside the ministry view it as being about 'defending Seoul'. (이날 정부도 국방부를 제외한 이유를 밝히지 않지만, 국방부 안팎에선 ‘서울 사수’ 때문으로 보는 사람이 많다.)

After Seoul was occupied by North Korean forces three days after the outbreak of the Korean War on June 25, 1950, 'defending Seoul' became the baseline of military security policy. At a New Year's press conference in January 1978, when then-President Park Chung-hee announced the relocation of the temporary administrative capital, the opposition at the time harshly criticized it as an abandonment of the concept of defending the capital region. (1950년 6월25일 한국전쟁 개전 3일 뒤 서울이 북한군에 점령된 이후 ‘서울 사수’는 군사안보정책의 기본값이 됐다. 1978년 1월 연두 기자회견에서 당시 박정희 대통령이 임시행정수도 이전을 밝히자, 당시 야당은 수도권 사수 개념 포기라고 강하게 비판했다.)

In the late 1980s, the Roh Tae-woo government attempted to move the Army, Navy, and Air Force headquarters from Seoul to Gyeryongdae in South Chungcheong Province, while leaving the Ministry of National Defense and the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) in Yongsan, Seoul. At the time, the Roh government cited balanced national development and population dispersal from the capital region as reasons for the move, but the security rationale of pulling the three service headquarters out of range of North Korean long-range artillery in case of contingency was significant. When it was announced that the three service headquarters would move to Gyeryongdae, doubts about 'defending Seoul' grew. (1980년대 말 노태우 정부는 국방부와 합동참모본부(합참)는 서울 용산에 그대로 남기고, 서울에 있던 육·해·공군 본부를 충남 계룡대로 이전하려고 했다. 당시 노태우 정부는 국토 균형발전, 수도권 인구 분산을 이전 이유로 내세웠지만, 3군 본부를 유사시 북한군 장사정포 사거리에서 빼려는 안보상 이유가 컸다. 당시 3군 본부가 계룡대로 내려간다고 하자 ‘서울 사수’에 의구심이 커졌다.)

On June 15, 1989, when the Army headquarters, then located at the site of today's War Memorial of Korea in Yongsan, Seoul, was moved to Gyeryongdae, Army Chief of Staff Lee Jong-gu explained, "There are concerns that the relocation of the three service headquarters could diminish the concept of defending Seoul, but the move facilitates military operations and aids in the defense of the capital region, and since the Ministry of National Defense and the JCS will remain in Seoul, there is no hindrance whatsoever to defending the capital area." After the three service headquarters completed their move to Gyeryongdae in 1993, the Ministry of National Defense, which remained in Yongsan, Seoul, became a symbol of 'defending Seoul'. (1989년 6월15일 현재 서울 용산 전쟁기념관 자리에 있던 육군본부를 계룡대로 옮길 때 이종구 육군참모총장은 “3군 본부 이전으로 서울 사수 개념이 퇴색하는 것 아니냐는 불안감이 커질 우려가 있으나 이전은 군 작전을 용이케 해 수도권 방위에 도움이 되며 국방부와 합참이 서울에 남아 있을 것이므로 수도권 사수에는 지장이 전혀 없다”고 설명했다. 1993년 3군 본부의 계룡대 이전 완료 이후 서울 용산에 자리 잡은 국방부는 ‘서울 사수’의 상징이 됐다.)

Arguments for moving the Ministry of National Defense and the JCS to Gyeryongdae surfaced during National Assembly audits or hearings for defense ministers and JCS chairmen. Proponents argued that the Ministry of National Defense and the JCS, located in Seoul within range of North Korean long-range artillery, should be moved to Gyeryongdae to ensure safety in the event of war and to strengthen joint operations among the Army, Navy, and Air Force. (국방부·합참의 계룡대 이전 주장은 국회 국정감사나 국방장관·합참의장 청문회 때면 등장했다. 찬성하는 쪽은 북한 장사정포 사정권에 놓인 서울의 국방부와 합참을 계룡대로 옮겨 전쟁 발발시 안전성을 확보하고 육해공군의 합동성을 강화해야 한다고 주장했다.)

Opponents argued that the current location is appropriate because △the Ministry of National Defense and the JCS should remain close to the national command authority (the presidential office) in Seoul to assist the president's wartime command, and △relocating to Gyeryongdae would undermine public confidence in 'defending Seoul in a contingency', heightening national security anxieties. (반대하는 쪽은 △국방부·합참은 국가통수기구(청와대)와 근접해 서울에서 대통령의 전쟁 지휘를 보좌해야 하며 △계룡대 이전시 ‘유사시 서울 사수’에 대한 믿음이 흔들려 국민의 안보 불안감이 커진다는 이유로 현재 위치가 적절하다고 주장했다.)

Currently, personnel at the Ministry of National Defense and the JCS work at the ministry and JCS headquarters in Yongsan, Seoul during peacetime, but move to the B1 bunker near the Capital Defense Command during wartime or ROK-U.S. combined exercises. The B1 bunker is where the JCS and the Ministry of National Defense, as well as the president and key government agencies, would enter to establish the wartime command center in a contingency. (현재 국방부, 합참 근무자들은 평시에는 서울 용산 국방부, 합참 청사에서 근무하다 전시나 한미연합연습 때는 수도방위사령부 근처 비(B)1벙커로 옮긴다. B1벙커는 유사시 합참과 국방부뿐만 아니라 대통령과 정부 주요 기관들이 들어와 전쟁지휘부를 꾸리는 곳이다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: "Supreme Court Justice Nominee Kim Sung-soo Lived in Brother-in-law's Home, Owed 34 Months of Rent" (주진우 “김성수 대법관 후보, 처남 집 살며 월세 34개월치 미납”)
item.description:
Allegations have been raised that Supreme Court Justice nominee Kim Sung-soo lived in an apartment in Gangnam-gu, Seoul leased by his brother-in-law while failing to pay 34 months' worth of rent. (김성수 대법관 후보자가 처남이 임차한 서울 강남구 아파트에 살면서 34개월치 월세를 미납했다는 의혹이 제기됐다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo released a statement on the 4th saying, "In the account transaction records submitted as proof of payment by nominee Kim, the last payment was 1.6 million won on November 2, 2023, and there are no further rent payments to date," adding, "He did not pay the monthly rent of 800,000 won for 34 months, from November 2023 through August 2026." He continued, "Even though the new sublease contract drawn up in 2025 stipulates a monthly rent of 800,000 won, payments were not resumed," and claimed, "The total unpaid amount reaches 27.2 million won." <<> According to the asset declaration records, resident registration data, and property registry documents that Kim submitted to the National Assembly, Kim lived in his brother-in-law's Yeoksam e-Pyunhansesang apartment (25 pyeong) in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, from February 2011 to June 2021, paying a jeonse deposit of 350 million won. Additionally, from June 2021, he entered into a sublease agreement to live in a 43-pyeong unit at Dogok Rexle apartment, which his brother-in-law had contracted, under terms of a 350 million won deposit and monthly rent of 800,000 won (equivalent to around 200 million won if converted to deposit). However, according to Joo, the account transaction records show that Kim stopped paying rent to his brother-in-law starting December 2023. <<> Earlier, Kim's side had explained that "at the urging of his mother-in-law, who was concerned about her unmarried brother-in-law, nominee Kim's family and the brother-in-law moved into the apartment together in 2021," stating that Kim's family and the brother-in-law lived under one roof. In response, Joo said, "The claim that a wealthy brother-in-law in his 50s, who had lived separately for over a decade, suddenly moved in with his sister's family defies common sense," and argued, "Kim and his brother-in-law must submit mobile phone location records, credit card usage history, and vehicle access logs to clarify whether they actually resided together at Dogok Rexle." <<> Joo further stated, "The suspicions of rent-free residence and evasion of gift tax have been confirmed as true," adding, "Kim should pay the evaded gift tax and immediately step down from his position as Supreme Court Justice nominee." <<> By Jang Na-rae, staff reporter wing@hani.co.kr (주진우 국민의힘 의원은 4일 보도자료를 내어 “김성수 후보자가 지급 증빙으로 제출한 계좌 거래내역에는 2023년 11월2일 160만원을 마지막으로 현재까지 (월세) 추가 지급 내역이 전혀 없다”며 “2023년 11월분부터 2026년 8월분까지 34개월간 월 80만원을 지급하지 않은 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “2025년 작성된 새로운 전대차계약서에도 월 80만원을 지급하도록 돼 있지만 지급은 재개되지 않았다”며 “총 미지급액은 2720만원에 달한다”고 주장했다.)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating hits record low of 40%... disapproval at record high of 51% [Gallup] (이 대통령 지지율 40% 최저…부정 평가는 51% 최고 [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 4th showed that positive evaluations of President Lee Jae-myung's administration of state affairs stood at 40%, the lowest since his inauguration. (이재명 대통령의 국정 운영에 대한 긍정 평가가 40%로 취임 이후 최저치를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 4일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Korea Gallup from the 1st to the 3rd among 1,001 people aged 18 or older nationwide (with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via telephone interview), positive evaluations of the President's job performance were 40%, while negative evaluations were 51%. The positive rating marks the lowest figure in Gallup's polls since his inauguration, and the negative rating is the highest. The positive rating fell 2 percentage points from last week's same survey (42%), while the negative rating rose 1 percentage point from last week's survey (50%). (한국갤럽이 지난 1∼3일 전국 만 18살 이상 1001명을 대상으로 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 전화면접조사)한 결과, 이 대통령 직무수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 40%였고, 부정 평가는 51%였다. 긍정 평가는 갤럽 조사에서 취임 뒤 최저치, 부정 평가는 최고치다. 긍정평가는 지난주 같은 조사(42%)보다 2%포인트 하락했고, 부정 평가는 지난주 조사(50%) 보다 1%포인트 올랐다.)

Reasons cited for positive evaluations included the economy and people's livelihoods (14%), diplomacy (13%), doing generally well (10%), communication (8%), and real estate policy (6%). Among reasons for negative evaluations, real estate policy (23%) ranked highest, followed by the economy and people's livelihoods (11%), personnel appointments (9%), issues of morality and avoidance of his own trial (6%), and doing poorly overall (6%). Gallup explained, "The increase in mentions of personnel issues this week appears to stem from the aftermath of the reshuffle replacing ministers in six ministries," adding, "The real estate issue has consistently topped the list of reasons for negative evaluations since the fourth week of July." (긍정 평가 이유로는 경제·민생(14%), 외교(13%), 전반적으로 잘한다(10%), 소통(8%), 부동산 정책(6%) 등이 꼽혔다. 부정 평가 이유로는 부동산 정책(23%)이 가장 많았고, 경제·민생(11%), 인사(9%), 도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피(6%), 전반적으로 잘못한다(6%) 등이 지목됐다. 갤럽은 “이번 주 인사 문제 지적 증가는 6개 부처 장관 교체 인선 여파로 보인다”며 “부동산 문제는 7월 넷째 주부터 줄곧 부정 평가 이유 최상위에 올라 있다”고 설명했다.)

Party support ratings were: Democratic Party of Korea 38%, People Power Party 30%, Fatherland Innovation Party 3%, Reform Party 1%, Progressive Party 1%, and independents 25%. In last week's survey, the Democratic Party stood at 39% and the People Power Party at 25%. Gallup said, "The People Power Party's support of 30% is the highest since the launch of the current government, and it is the fourth time the ruling party's support has fallen below 40%," adding, "This marks the first time the gap between the two major parties has been within 10 percentage points since the current government took office." (정당 지지율은 더불어민주당 38%, 국민의힘 30%, 조국혁신당 3%, 개혁신당 1%, 진보당 1%, 무당층 25%로 나타났다. 지난주 조사에선 더불어민주당 39%, 국민의힘 25%였다. 갤럽은 “국민의힘 지지도 30%는 현 정부 출범 후 최고치고, 여당 지지도가 40%를 밑돌기는 네 번째”라며 “양대 정당 격차 10%포인트 이내 기록은 현 정부 출범 이후 처음”이라고 했다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: President Yoon to Make State Visit to France June 6-9 at Macron's Invitation (이 대통령, 마크롱 초청으로 6~9일 프랑스 국빈방문 한다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung is set to make a state visit to France from the 6th to the 9th at the invitation of French President Emmanuel Macron. (이재명 대통령이 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령의 초청으로 6일부터 9일까지 프랑스를 국방문할 예정이다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said at a briefing at the presidential office on the 4th, "This visit to France follows French President Macron, who visited Korea in April, inviting President Lee as co-chair of the 'Lumière Summit' and proposing a state visit to France on that occasion." (위성락 국가안보실장은 4일 청와대 브리핑에서 “이번 프랑스 방문은 지난 4월 방한한 마크롱 프랑스 대통령이 이 대통령을 ‘뤼미에르 서밋’ 공동의장으로 초청하고 이 계기에 프랑스 국빈방문을 제안해 온 데 따른 것”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee will arrive in France on the evening of the 6th and, the following day, the 7th, will attend the 'Lumière Summit,' an international film and media summit held in Saint-Paul-de-Vence in southern France, as co-chair alongside President Macron. (이 대통령은 6일 저녁 프랑스에 도착해 다음날인 7일 프랑스 남부 생폴드방스에서 개최되는 국제 영화·영상 정상회의인 ‘뤼미에르 서밋’에 마크롱 대통령과 공동의장으로 참석한다.)

He will then have a two-day bilateral schedule in Paris as a state guest starting on the 8th. After laying a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at the Arc de Triomphe, he will attend an official welcome ceremony hosted by the French government. Following a one-on-one lunch with President Macron at the Élysée Palace, an expanded summit meeting with both delegations will take place. After a Korea-France business roundtable, he will attend a state banquet hosted by President Macron and his wife at the Élysée Palace. (이어 8일부터 이틀간 파리에서 국빈으로서 양자방문 일정을 가질 예정이다. 개선문에서 무명용사의 묘에 헌화한 뒤 프랑스 정부가 주최하는 공식환영식에 참석한다. 엘리제궁에서 마크롱 대통령과 양 정상이 참석하는 단독오찬 뒤 양국대표단이 참석하는 확대 정상회담이 열린다. 한-프랑스 비즈니스 라운드테이블 뒤에는 마크롱 대통령 내외가 엘리제궁에서 주최하는 국빈만찬에 참석한다.)

On the 9th, he will meet with Yaël Braun-Pivet, President of the French National Assembly, hold a luncheon meeting with Korean residents in France, and meet with Mathias Cormann, Secretary-General of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), before returning home. (9일에는 브론-피베 프랑스 하원의장 면담과 프랑스 동포오찬간담회, 마팅스 코먼 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 사무총장 접견한 뒤 귀국한다.)

Director Wi said, "We expect this state visit to serve as an opportunity to solidify the 'Global Strategic Partnership' with France, elevated in April, through practical cooperation encompassing security, economy, and people-to-people exchanges, and to add new momentum to expanding our diplomacy toward Europe." Director Wi added, "We will expand cooperation with France, a leader in future industries, in cutting-edge technology fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), space, nuclear energy, and bio, and revitalize exchanges in youth and science and technology to further strengthen the foundation for sustainable development of bilateral relations." (위 실장은 “이번 국빈방문을 계기로 안보와 경제·인적교류를 아우르는 실질협력을 통해 지난 4월 격상된 프랑스와의 ‘글로벌 전략적 동반자 관계’를 내실화하고, 우리 대유럽 외교 확대에 새로운 동력을 더하는 계기가 될 것으로 기대한다”고 말했다. 위 실장은 이어 “미래산업 선도국인 프랑스와 인공지능(AI)·우주·원자력·바이오 등 첨단기술 분야의 협력을 확대하고, 청년·과학기술 분야의 교류를 활성화해 양국 관계의 지속가능한 발전 기반을 더욱 탄탄히 다질 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Losses Exceed 56 Trillion Won"... People Power Party Submits Request for Parliamentary Investigation into 'Samsung-SK Hynix Leverage' (“손실 56조 넘어”…국힘, ‘삼전닉스 레버리지’ 국정조사 요구서 제출)
item.description:
The People Power Party has submitted a request for a parliamentary investigation into the introduction of single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which are cited as a factor amplifying stock market volatility. (국민의힘이 주식시장 변동성을 키우는 원인으로 지목받는 단일종목 레버리지 이티에프(ETF)의 도입에 대한 국정조사 요구서를 제출했다.)

People Power Party Chief Deputy Whip Kim Seung-su, Policy Chief Deputy Whip Kim Mi-ae, and Rep. Seo Il-jun, the secretary of the National Assembly's Standing Committee on Political Affairs, submitted the "Request for a Parliamentary Investigation into the Truth Behind Losses Incurred by Retail Investors in Specific Single-Stock Leveraged ETFs" to the Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Office on the 4th. (국민의힘 김승수 원내운영수석부대표와 김미애 원내정책수석부대표, 국회 정무위원회 간사인 서일준 의원은 4일 국회 의안과에 ‘특정 단일종목 레버리지 이티에프 개인투자자 손실에 대한 진상규명 국정조사 요구서’를 제출했다.)

Rep. Seo stated, "The parliamentary investigation into single-stock leveraged ETFs is not for political strife but a request for an investigation for the sake of people's livelihoods," adding, "I expect the Democratic Party will also take part in the investigation." He continued, "Financial policies have too great an impact on citizens' assets," and "It is necessary to thoroughly examine how the process of introducing single-stock leveraged ETFs came about, whether the problems were analyzed, and to dig deep into that process." (서 의원은 “단일종목 레버리지 이티에프 국정조사는 정쟁을 위한 게 아니라 민생을 위한 국정조사 요구”라며 “민주당도 국정조사에 임할 것으로 기대하고 있다”고 말했다. 그는 “금융 정책이 국민들의 재산에 미치는 영향이 너무 크다”며 “단일종목 레버리지 이티에프 도입 과정이 도대체 어떻게 도입됐는지, 문제점에 대해 분석했는지, 그 과정을 철저히 파헤치는 것이 필요하다”고 덧붙였다.)

Chief Deputy Whip Kim Seung-su said, "According to a tracking investigation by a professional institution, losses from single-stock leveraged ETFs have been found to exceed 56 trillion won," adding, "Victims who lost everything — money earned through blood, sweat, and tears, wedding funds, and retirement savings — are desperately waiting for a parliamentary investigation and even a special counsel to clearly determine responsibility and firmly punish those who must be held accountable." He further stated, "There is no reason or justification for the ruling party to oppose this," and "I expect and urge them to promptly respond to the parliamentary investigation, and if problems are found, to immediately agree to a special counsel as well." (김승수 운영수석은 “이티에프 단일종목 레버리지로 인한 손실액이 전문기관의 추적조사에 의하면 56조원이 넘는다는 조사까지 나왔다”며 “피땀 흘려 모은 돈이라든지 결혼자금, 노후자금까지 몽땅 날린 피해자들은 국정조사는 물론이고 특검을 통해 명확하게 책임소재를 규명해 처벌해야 할 부분은 단호하게 처벌해줄 것을 학수고대하는 상황”이라고 말했다. 이어 “여당이 반대할 이유와 명분이 없다”며 “빨리 국정조사에 응해주고, 문제점이 발견되면 즉시 특검까지 합의해줄 것으로 기대하고 또 촉구한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Confirmation Hearing for Justice Minister Nominee Kim Seung-won to Be Held on the 15th (김승원 법무장관 후보자 국회 인사청문회 15일 개최)
item.description:
The National Assembly's confirmation hearing for Kim Seung-won, nominee for Minister of Justice, will take place on the 15th. (김승원 법무부 장관 후보자에 대한 국회 인사청문회가 오는 15일 열린다.)

An official from the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee told the Hankyoreh on the 4th that the confirmation hearing for Kim will be held by the committee on the 15th. Accordingly, the committee plans to hold a plenary session on the 9th to adopt the hearing implementation plan and related documents. (국회 법제사법위원회 관계자는 4일 한겨레에 김 후보자 인사청문회가 오는 15일 법사위에서 열릴 예정이라고 밝혔다. 이에 법사위는 오는 9일 전체회의를 열어 인사청문회 실시계획서 등을 채택할 계획이다.)

Earlier, the ruling and opposition parties, through consultations between their chief deputies on the relevant standing committees, had agreed to hold confirmation hearings on the 15th for Lee Hyung-il, nominee for Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance, and Lee So-young, nominee for Minister of SMEs and Startups, and on the 16th for Kang Shin-chul, nominee for Minister of National Defense, and Hong Ji-seon, nominee for Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. (앞서 여야는 소관 상임위의 여야 간사 협의 등을 통해 오는 15일 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관 후보자와 이소영 중소벤처기업부 장관 후보자, 오는 16일 강신철 국방부 장관 후보자와 홍지선 국토교통부 장관 후보자에 대한 인사청문회를 각각 열기로 한 바 있다.)

Among the six ministerial appointments announced in the cabinet reshuffle on the 30th of last month, the schedule for the confirmation hearing for Yong Hye-in, nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, has not yet been confirmed. (지난달 30일 발표된 6개 부처 장관 개각 인사 가운데 용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자에 대한 인사청문회 일정은 아직 확정되지 않았다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae: "Dispatch to Hormuz Under Review Per Procedures... Nothing Decided" (청와대 “호르무즈 파병, 절차 따라 검토 중…정해진 건 없다”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae said on the 4th regarding the dispatch to the Strait of Hormuz that "it is at the review stage, but nothing has been decided." (청와대가 4일 호르무즈해협 파병과 관련해 “검토 단계에 있지만, 정해진 건 없다”고 말했다.)

A senior Cheong Wa Dae official met with reporters and said, "Freedom of navigation in Hormuz is a very important part of our national interests," adding, "When the U.S. proposed an international coalition for freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, we have a history of actively participating and consulting from the outset, and when discussing such matters, we have said we would consider various readiness postures on the Korean Peninsula and review them in accordance with domestic legal procedures." He added, "Nothing has been decided, but we are continuously reviewing it." (청와대 고위관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “호르무즈에서의 자유로운 통항은 우리의 국익에 굉장히 중요한 부분”이라며 “미국이 호르무즈해협 자유 통항을 위한 국제적 연대를 제안했을 적에 우리는 처음부터 적극 참여하면서 협의해온 경위가 있고, 그런 걸 논의할 때 여러 가지 한반도 대비 태세를 감안하고, 국내 법적 절차에 따라 검토하겠다고 한 바 있다”며 “정해진 건 없지만, 저희가 계속 검토하고 있다”고 말했다.)

The official further stated, "Countries like the U.K. and France have already dispatched ships or are operating in the region," and "We are at a slightly later stage, conducting various reviews and consultations. Given our dependence on the Strait of Hormuz and national interests, we have consistently expressed our position to make practical contributions, and since we are in that state now, it is still too early to say more." (이 관계자는 이어 “영국과 프랑스 등 몇몇 나라는 이미 그 지역에 선박을 파견하거나 활동을 하고 있다”며 “우리는 그것보다 조금 늦은 단계에서 여러 검토와 협의를 하는 것이다. 저희가 호르무즈해협 의존도나 국익을 감안할 때 실질적 기여를 하겠다는 입장을 그동안 쭉 표명해왔고, 지금 그 상태에 있기 때문에 더 나아가서 말하기는 아직은 좀 이르다”고 말했다.)

The senior Cheong Wa Dae official said, "We are conducting multiple reviews regarding readiness on the Korean Peninsula, and we believe we can maneuver within a scope that does not significantly undermine our posture toward the U.S.," while adding, "I think the domestic legal procedures refer to consultation and consent with the National Assembly. We have not yet reached that stage." He then added, "We are proceeding with the review, and since we are at the stage of examining how to handle necessary issues, nothing has been decided." ( 청와대 고위관계자는 “한반도의 대비태세와 관련해 우리가 여러 검토를 하고 있는데, 대미 태세에 큰 손상이 있지 않는 범위 내에서 운신할 수 있다는 생각을 하고 있다”면서도 “국내법적 절차라고 하는 게 국회와의 협의, 동의를 의미하는 거라고 생각한다. 아직 그 단계까지는 가 있지 않다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “검토를 진행하고 있고, 필요한 사안들은 어떻게 하고 있는지 검토하고 있는 단계이기 때문에 결정된 바 없다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: President Lee, amid 'falling approval ratings,' holds civic society meeting... "Civic groups have a large role in grand social reform" (‘지지율 하락’ 이 대통령, 시민사회 간담회...“사회 대개혁 시민단체 몫 커”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 4th, "I believe that civic groups have a very significant role to play in the grand social reform we must undertake." (이재명 대통령이 4일 “우리가 해야 될 사회 대개혁에도 우리 시민단체들의 몫은 매우 크다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

At a 'civic society invitation meeting' he chaired at the presidential office (Cheong Wa Dae) that day, the President said, "The world you hope for or want to create is not likely to differ greatly from the world I want to create," adding, "However, the paths and methods to reach that goal may differ somewhat. But I don't think those differences are large." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 ‘시민사회 초청 간담회’에서 “여러분이 원하거나 만들고자 하는 세상이나 제가 만들고 싶은 세상이나 크게 다르지 않을 것”이라며 “다만 그 목표에 이르는 경로와 방식이 조금씩은 다를 수 있다. 그러나 그 차이는 크지 않다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

The President continued, "I believe your dream is to create a community where everyone is treated fairly and with respect, and lives together," and said, "Let us work together to develop good measures and good programs, and build a nation where our people have hope, a developing country, a world where fair and transparent systems operate." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “모든 사람들이 공정하게 존중받고 함께 살아가는 공동체 그런 세상을 만드는 게 아마 여러분들의 꿈이라고 생각한다”며 “우리 함께 좋은 방안들을 또 좋은 프로그램들을 함께 만들어가면서 우리 국민들이 희망을 가지는, 발전하는 나라, 공정하고 투명한 시스템이 작동하는 그런 세상을 만들어보면 좋겠다”고 말했다.)

The President added, "In the early days of my term, things were hectic with various matters, making it difficult to listen carefully to your views, but today I will listen attentively to what you have to say." (이 대통령은 이어 “취임 초기 좀 여러 가지 일들로 번잡해서 여러분의 말씀을 자세히 듣기 어려웠는데, 오늘은 여러분이 하시는 말씀을 잘 경청하도록 하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Amid a recent continued decline in approval ratings, it is noteworthy that the President has moved to expand engagement with civic society. There are also interpretations that this step aims to secure momentum for governance by not only expanding the moderate camp but also re-galvanizing the cohesion of reform-minded supporters and civic groups who backed the launch of the administration. (최근 지지율 하락세가 이어지는 가운데 이 대통령이 시민사회와의 접점을 넓히고 나선 점은 주목된다. 중도층 확장에 더해 정부 출범을 뒷받침했던 개혁 성향 지지층과 시민사회의 결집력을 다시 끌어올려 국정 동력을 확보하려는 행보라는 해석도 나온다.)

Indeed, attendees at the meeting included Kim Jun-woo, Secretary General of Lawyers for a Democratic Society; Kim Seong-dal, Secretary General of the Citizens' Coalition for Economic Justice; Kim Hui-sang, Secretary General of the Korean Peasants' League; Bang Hak-jin, Secretary General of the Institute for Research in National Issues; Jo Hang-a, Secretary General of the National Alliance of Democratic Street Vendors; Choe Eun-a, Secretary General of the Alliance for Independent Unification and Peace; Lee Eun-jeong, Co-representative of the Korean Women's Association United; and Yang Yi-hyeon-gyeong, Co-representative of the Korean Women's Associations United, among others from various civic groups. (실제 이날 회의에는 김준우 민주사회를위한변호사모임 사무총장, 김성달 경제정의실천연합 사무총장, 김희상 전국농민회총연맹 사무총장, 방학진 민족문제연구소 사무처장, 조항아 민주노점상전국연합 사무총장, 최은아 자주통일평화연대 사무처장, 이은정 전국여성연대 상임대표, 양이현경 한국여성단체연합 상임대표 등 다양한 시민단체에서 참석했다.)

Regarding the meeting that day, the presidential office stated, "As we enter the second year of the people-sovereignty government, with diverse opinions emerging from all sectors of society, the meeting was arranged to meet with civic society figures, listen to voices from the field, and narrow the gap between policy and practice." (청와대는 이날 간담회와 관련해 “국민주권정부 출범 2년 차에 사회 각계에서 다양한 의견이 도출되는 상황에서, 시민사회 관계자들과 만나 현장의 목소리를 경청하고 정책과 현장의 거리를 좁히기 위해 마련됐다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae: "Semiconductors Also on the Table for U.S. Investment Talks... Security Negotiations Not Easy to Advance" (청와대 “대미투자 반도체도 논의 대상…안보협상 진행 쉽지 않아”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae said on the 4th, "It is true that semiconductors are also among the topics under discussion regarding investment in the United States." (청와대가 4일 “대미투자 이슈 중에는 반도체도 논의 대상인 게 사실”이라고 말했다.)

A senior Cheong Wa Dae official told reporters that day, "As far as I know, the U.S. side has made such a proposal, and so it is a reality that it has become a subject of discussion," adding, "How and in what way it will be concluded does not seem to have been decided yet. Since the U.S. side raised it at an early stage, I would only say that it has become a subject of discussion." The United States is reportedly demanding the construction of a memory semiconductor plant in the U.S. as part of the investment negotiation process. ( 청와대 고위관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “제가 알기로는 미측에서 그런 제기가 있고, 그래서 논의 대상이 된 것은 현실”이라며 “어떻게 어떤 방식으로 귀결될지는 아직 정해지지 않은 거 같다. 초기 단계에서 미측이 제기했기 때문에 논의 대상이 된 정도라고만 말씀드리겠다”고 말했다. 현재 미국은 대미투자 협상 과정에서 미국 반도체내 메모리 공장 건설을 요구하는 것으로 전해졌다.)

The official also said that tariff and security negotiations between South Korea and the U.S. have fallen back into a deadlock. "The security negotiations between South Korea and the U.S. proceeded in accordance with the joint fact sheet, but temporarily stalled earlier this year. We made a lot of efforts to restore them, and they were restored around May," the senior official said. "So they were progressing, but now it is not easy to move them forward again. They are linked to various other issues." ( 아울러 한·미 간 관세·안보 협상도 다시 교착 국면에 빠진 상황이라고 말했다. 이 고위 관계자는 “한·미 간 안보협상은 조인트팩트시트에 따라 진행되다가 올해 초 일시적으로 ​잠시 정체 상태에 이른 적이 있다. 그걸 다시 복원시키기 위한 많은 노력을 했고, 다시 복원된 게 5월께”라며 “그래서 진행이 됐는데, 지금 다시 진행하기가 쉽지 않다. ​여러 가지 다른 이슈와 연결된 상황”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok, on Han Dong-hoon’s “Attacks on Kim Seung-won”: “A Shooting Spree… They Don’t Engage the People Power Party” (김민석, ‘김승원 공세’ 한동훈에 “총기 난사하는 행태…국힘 상대안해주니”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 4th regarding independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who continues to raise suspicions of “new drug lobbying” against Kim Seung-won, nominee for Minister of Justice, that Han is “showing a sudden shooting-spree behavior” and added, “I hope the party will simply refrain from responding to Han’s claims.” The Democratic Party also directed its criticism at the People Power Party, saying it is “waging a foot-dragging political offensive,” and rallied in unison to shield nominee Kim. (김민석 더불어민주당 대표가 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자의 식품의약품안전처 ‘신약로비’ 의혹을 계속 제기 중인 한동훈 무소속 의원을 향해 “갑자기 총기 난사하는 행태를 보이고 있다”며 “한 의원의 문제제기에 대해서 당에서는 굳이 답하지 않는 것으로 정리했으면 좋겠다”고 4일 밝혔다. 민주당은 이날 국민의힘을 향해서도 “발목잡기식 정치 공세를 벌이고 있다”며 한 목소리로 김 후보자 엄호에 나섰다.)

At the conclusion of the Supreme Council meeting held at the South Chungcheong provincial government office that day, Kim said, “Lawmaker Han seems to still not have a grasp on the direction of his legislative activities. Whenever various issues arise recently, instead of reflecting on matters he should reflect on, he suddenly shows a shooting-spree pattern.” ( 김 대표는 이날 충남도청에서 열린 최고위원회의 마무리 발언에서 “한 의원이 의정활동의 방향을 아직 감을 잘 못 잡고 있는 것 같다. 최근에 여러가지 일이 나올 때마다 본인이 성찰해야 될 사안에 대해 성찰하지 않고 갑자기 총기 난사하는 형태를 보이고 있다”고 했다.)

Kim said, “Perhaps because the People Power Party does not engage with him, he keeps showing this much attention to the Democratic Party,” and added, “I hope he will maintain a consistent focus in the direction of his legislative activities.” ( 김 대표는 “아마 국민의힘에서 상대를 안 해줘서 민주당에 자꾸 이렇게 관심을 가지시는 것 같다”며 “의정활동의 방향을 일관되게 초점을 가졌으면 좋겠다”고 했다. )

Kim continued, “Because we do not have time to keep paying attention and responding to problem-raising in the wrong direction, I heard from the spokesperson’s office that our party’s spokesperson, Cho Kye-won, will continue to respond to lawmaker Han’s erroneous claims or questions,” and added, “Therefore, from now on, I hope the party will make it a policy not to bother responding to lawmaker Han’s claims.” ( 이어 김 대표는 “잘못된 방향의 문제 제기에 대해서 당이 자꾸 관심을 가지고 답할 시간이 없기 때문에 우리 당에서는 조계원 대변인께서 한 의원의 잘못된 문제제기나 궁금증에 대해 지속적으로 답해드리기로 했다는 것을 제가 대변인실에서 들었다”며 “그렇기 때문에 앞으로 당에서는 굳이 한 의원의 문제 제기에 답하지 않는 것으로 그렇게 정리했으면 좋겠다”고 했다. )

The Democratic Party also took a unified stance in defending nominee Kim against the People Power Party, saying, “Do not dress up abusive language and mockery as rigorous vetting.” ( 민주당은 국민의힘을 향해서도 “막말과 조롱을 송곳 검증으로 포장하지 말라”며 김 후보자 옹호에 일제히 나섰다. )

Floor leader Han Byeong-do said, “People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk’s abusive remarks are like a runaway locomotive with broken brakes. He flatly declared that nominee Kim committed clear bribery, and even went so far as to spew words close to a curse, saying Kim would go to prison hand in hand with the president.” He added, “It is deplorable that the leader of the main opposition party is invoking bribery and prison based on unverified suspicions.” ( 한병도 원내대표는 “장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 막말은 브레이크가 고장 난 폭주 기관차 같다”며 “김 후보를 향해 명백한 뇌물죄라고 단정하고, 급기야 대통령과 손잡고 감옥에 갈 것이라는 저주에 가까운 말까지 쏟아냈다”고 했다. 그는 “제1야당 대표가 확인되지 않은 의혹을 근거로 뇌물죄와 감옥을 운운한 것이 한심할 따름”이라고 했다. )

Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yun also said, “The claim that the suspension of indictment (received by nominee Kim over the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety suspicions) was a lenient deal is absurd. This case was investigated by the Yoon Seok-youl prosecution, and that was a time when the prosecution engaged in targeted and fabricated investigations against the opposition—how could it be plausible that the prosecution gave a lenient investigation to an opposition lawmaker who was a thorn in its side?” ( 이성윤 최고위원도 “(김 후보자가 식약처 의혹으로 받은) 기소유예가 봐주기라는 주장이 황당하다”며 “이 사건은 윤석열 검찰이 수사했고, 검찰이 야당에 대해 표적 수사, 조작 수사를 일삼았던 시기인데 눈엣가시 야당 의원을 검찰이 봐주기 수사했다는 게 가당키나 한가”라고 했다. )

Supreme Council member Han Min-su, targeting lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, said, “Lawmaker Han, who cannot tell whether he is a political prosecutor or a member of the National Assembly, has crossed the line with his political offensive. Pulling out a case that was never even indicted as if he had discovered some new crime only proves that he has not shed his bad habits from his political prosecutor days. If he has time to make baseless attacks, he should instead disclose his iPhone password.” ( 한민수 최고위원은 한동훈 의원을 겨냥해 “본인이 정치 검사인지 국회의원인지 분간을 못 하는 한 의원의 정치 공세가 도를 넘었다”며 “기소조차 하지 못했던 사안을 이제 와서 마치 새로운 범죄라도 발견한 양 꺼내 드는 건 정치 검사 시절의 나쁜 버릇을 하지 못했음을 스스로 입증할 뿐이다. 근거 없는 흠집 내기 할 시간이 있다면 본인의 아이폰 비번이나 공개하길 바란다”고 했다. )

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ( 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Intensive Search Underway for Likely Escape Routes of 9 Missing South Koreans in Nepal... Bridge Connecting Office Building and Lodging (네팔 연락두절 9명 ‘대피 추정 경로’ 집중 수색한다…사무동-숙소 잇는 다리)
item.description:
The Korea Disaster Relief Team (KDRT), dispatched by the South Korean government to Nepal, has been deployed to search for nine South Koreans who lost contact following massive flooding in Nepal, with plans on the 4th to conduct an intensive search around the bridge connecting the office building and lodging at the accident site. (한국 정부가 네팔에 파견한 해외긴급구호대(KDRT)가 네팔 대홍수로 연락 두절된 한국인 9명 수색에도 투입돼, 4일에는 사고 현장에서 사무동과 숙소를 연결하는 다리 쪽을 집중 수색할 계획이다.)

A foreign ministry official told reporters on the same day, "We will focus on the lower section of the Yellow Bridge (bridge) located upstream on the Trishuli River in Nepal." The Yellow Bridge spans the Trishuli River, where a hydropower plant is located, connecting the main camp on the right bank of the river to the lodging (powerhouse) on the left bank. The government's joint rapid response team has been concentrating its search on the Lamche area near the main camp, used as the office building, and the Dunche area near the weir dam where one South Korean worked. The search team currently identifies two main probable escape routes for the nine missing individuals: the mountainous area behind the main camp and the area near the Yellow Bridge. The foreign ministry official said, "(Of these) the Yellow Bridge has not yet been examined in detail, so we plan to focus on that area," adding that the families have also requested a search there. (외교부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “네팔 트리슐리강 위쪽에 있는 옐로 브릿지(다리) 하단 부분을 중점적으로 보게 될 것”이라고 말했다. 옐로 브릿지는 수력발전소가 있는 트리슐리강을 끼고 설치된 다리로, 강 오른 편에 있는 메인캠프와 왼편 숙소(파워하우스)를 이어준다. 정부 합동 신속대응팀은 사무동으로 쓰인 메인캠프 쪽과 가까운 람체 지역 및 한국인 1명이 근무한 위어댐 인근 둔체 지역을 집중 수색해 왔다. 수색팀은 현재 연락두절된 9명의 대피경로를 크게 두 곳으로 파악하는데, 메인캠프 뒤쪽 산지와 옐로 브릿지 쪽이다. 외교부 당국자는 “(이중) 옐로 브릿지는 아직 자세히 보지 않아 그 부분을 집중해 볼 예정”이라며 가족들도 이곳 수색을 원하고 있다고 전했다.)

The disaster relief team on the ground plans to consult again with Nepalese authorities on the same day regarding the resumption of helicopter operations and joint operation methods. Two land search team members currently remaining in the Dunche area plan to conduct searches while descending from Dunche. The previous day, the relief team received support for two helicopters with permission from the Nepalese military commander in the Bhatar area to conduct searches, but had to turn back due to adverse weather conditions. (현지에 있는 해외긴급구호대는 이날 헬기 재운항 및 합동 작전 방식 등을 놓고 네팔 당국과 다시 협의할 계획이다. 현재 둔체 지역에 남은 육로 수색 대원 2명은 둔체에서 내려오면서 수색을 진행할 예정이다. 전날 구호대는 네팔 바타르 지역 군사령관의 허가로 헬기 2대를 지원 받아 수색에 나섰지만, 기상 악화로 회항할 수밖에 없었다.)

Meanwhile, one body discovered by the rapid response team near the Upper Trishuli (UT-1) power plant at the accident site on the 1st has been confirmed by police not to be a South Korean national. However, the South Korean Embassy in Nepal continues to verify the identity of one body found inside the tunnel of this power plant on the 31st of last month. A foreign ministry official explained the reason for the delay in confirmation, stating, "There are currently many bodies found, and there are significant differences in DNA analysis between Nepal and South Korea." (한편, 지난 1일 신속대응팀이 사고 지점인 어퍼트리슐리(UT-1) 발전소 인근에서 발견한 주검 1구는 경찰 확인 결과 한국인이 아닌 것으로 확인됐다. 다만 지난달 31일 이 발전소 터널 안에서 발견된 주검 1구에 대한 신원 확인은 주네팔한국대사관이 계속 확인 중이다. 외교부 당국자는 “현재 (발견된) 시신이 굉장히 많고, 디엔에이(DNA) 분석 등이 네팔과 우리나라의 차이가 꽤 많다”고 확인이 늦어지는 이유를 설명했다.)

The government also decided on the same day to provide emergency relief supplies worth 130 million won to Nepal to help flood victims. The foreign ministry said that 36,000 emergency thermal blankets and 2,320 medium-weight thermal blankets are expected to arrive in Nepal via commercial flight around the 5th. (정부는 홍수 피해 이재민을 돕기 위해 네팔에 1억3000만원 규모의 긴급 구호 물품도 신속 지원하기로 이날 결정했다. 비상보온담요 3만6000점, 중보온담요 2320점 등이 5일께 민항기로 네팔에 도착할 예정이라고 이날 외교부는 밝혔다.)

Jang Ye-ji Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Defense Minister Nominee Kang Shin-cheol Reports 1.1 Billion Won in Assets; Eldest Son Discharged from Army (국방 강신철 후보자 11억원 재산 신고…장남 육군 장교 전역)
item.description:
Kang Shin-cheol, nominee for Minister of National Defense, has reported assets totaling 1.12762 billion won, including deposits and real estate held under his name, his spouse's name, and his children's names, ahead of the parliamentary confirmation hearing. (강신철 국방부 장관 후보자가 국회 인사청문회를 앞두고 본인과 배우자, 자녀 명의의 예금과 부동산 등 11억2762만원의 재산을 신고했다.)

According to the confirmation hearing request submitted to the National Assembly on the 4th, Kang reported personal assets of 1.01355 billion won. The amount reflects an apartment in Umyeon-dong, Seocho-gu, Seoul valued at 1.238 billion won, a 2025-model Tucson automobile worth 43.97 million won, deposits of 56.8 million won, and financial liabilities of 325.22 million won. (4일 국회에 제출된 강 후보자의 인사청문요청안을 보면 강 후보자 본인은 10억1355만원의 재산을 신고했다. 서울 서초구 우면동 아파트 12억3800만원, 2025년식 투싼 자동차 4397만원, 예금 5680만원과 금융채무 3억2522만원이 반영된 액수다.)

Kang's spouse holds assets totaling 27.3 million won, including a 2019-model Tucson vehicle worth 9.74 million won and deposits of 17.56 million won. His eldest son reported 71.99 million won, consisting of deposits of 32.84 million won and securities of 39.15 million won, while his eldest daughter reported 14.76 million won, including a leasehold right to a residence in Germany valued at 160,000 won and deposits of 14.69 million won. Kang's father refused to disclose his assets on the grounds of maintaining an independent livelihood. (강 후보자의 배우자는 2019년식 투싼 차량 974만원과 예금 1756만원 등 모두 2730만원을 보유했다. 장남은 예금 3284만과 증권 3915만원 등 7199만원, 장녀는 독일 소재 거주지 전세(임차권)권 16만원과 예금 1469만원 등 1476만원을 각각 신고했다. 강 후보자 부친은 독립생계 유지를 이유로 고지를 거부했다.)

Kang's eldest son has been discharged from the Army upon completing his mandatory service as a first lieutenant. (강 후보자 장남은 육군 중위로 만기전역했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung stated in the written request for the confirmation hearing: "(Kang) combines extensive experience in the defense sector with expertise in military strategy and defense policy," adding, "He is the most suitable candidate for Minister of National Defense to strengthen self-reliant defense capabilities in preparation for future warfare based on a robust ROK-U.S. alliance and to drive defense innovation with speed." (이재명 대통령은 인사청문 요청 사유서에서 “(강 후보자는) 국방 분야의 풍부한 경험과 군사전략, 국방정책 전문성을 겸비했다”며 “굳건한 한미동맹을 바탕으로 미래전에 대비한 자주 국방 역량을 강화하고 국방 혁신을 속도감 있게 추진할 수 있는 국방부 장관 최적임자”라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: 'Red Team' Cho Kuk: "I Offered My Loyalty to Repay a Debt, but They Made Me Another 'Anti-Myung'" (‘레드팀’ 조국 “은혜 갚으려 충정 제안했는데, 날 반명 만들어”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, head of the Innovation Policy Research Institute of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, who has positioned himself as a "red team" for President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party of Korea, said of the party: "I knocked loudly on the 'front gate' as a warning signal to properly repay a 'debt of gratitude,' but they throw filth at me, calling it noise." (이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당의 ‘레드팀’을 자처하고 나선 조국 조국혁신당 혁신정책연구원장이 민주당을 향해 “‘은혜’를 제대로 갚기 위해 경고 신호로 ‘대문’을 크게 두드렸더니, 시끄럽다며 오물을 투척한다”고 말했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 4th, Cho wrote: "When I presented the objective situation and countermeasures out of sincere loyalty, they attack me outright, calling it 'ingratitude' or 'beating on a boarded-up window.'" (조 원장은 4일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “충정으로 객관적 상황과 대처 방안을 제시하니, 거두절미하고 ‘배은망덕’ 또는 ‘봉창 두드린다’며 공격한다”고 이렇게 말했다.)

Cho added: "That kind of slander and mockery will do nothing to help resolve the president's problems or recover approval ratings. And what good would creating another 'Anti-Myung' do for the president?" (조 원장은 “그런 식의 비방과 조롱(은), 대통령이 처한 문제 해결에도 국정지지율 회복에도 전혀 도움이 안 될 것”이라며 “그리고 또 한 명의 ‘반명’을 만들어내는 것이 대통령에게 무슨 도움이 되겠는가”라고 했다.)

On the 1st, Cho posted on Facebook about the withdrawal of the indictment in cases related to President Lee and the special counsel act on fabricated prosecutions, saying, "Any law that gives the impression of being made for a specific individual alone will fail. To withdraw an indictment on grounds of fabricated prosecution, the fabrication must first be confirmed." In response, the Democratic Party issued sharp rebukes, with senior Supreme Council member Park Sun-won saying, "This cannot be called the language of a comrade. We have no choice but to call it ingratitude," and five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won commenting, "There's someone here again beating on a boarded-up window in their sleep. It's frustrating that people who were once so astute are acting this way." (지난 1일 조 원장은 페이스북에 이 대통령 관련 사건 공소취소와 조작기소특검법에 대해 “어떤 법률이 특정 개인만을 위해 만들어진다는 인상을 주면 실패한다”며 “조작기소를 이유로 공소취소를 하려면 조작기소가 확인되어야 한다”는 글을 올렸다. 그러자 민주당에서는 “동지의 언어라고 할 수 없다. 배은망덕이라 말할 수밖에 없다”(박선원 최고위원), “여기도 또 자다가 봉창 때리는 분이 있다. 영특하셨던 분들이 왜 이러시는지 답답하다”(5선 박지원 의원)는 날선 반응이 나왔다.)

item.title: DP says "Han Dong-hoon should be the one to receive a special counsel" regarding 'protection of Kim Seung-won', "undergo phone forensics" (‘김승원 엄호’ 민주 “한동훈, 특검 받아야 할 사람...핸드폰 포렌식 받길”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea, addressing independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon who continues to raise suspicions of a "new drug lobbying" scandal at the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety against Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, said, "He has remained in cowardly silence regarding his own suspicions. Raising fairness and justice now is a deplorable deception of the people," and added, "He should undergo phone forensics first." (더불어민주당이 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자의 식품의약품안전처 ‘신약 로비’ 의혹을 계속 제기 중인 한동훈 무소속 의원에게 “본인 의혹에 관해서는 비겁한 침묵으로 일관했다. 이제 와서 공정과 정의를 거론하는 건 참담한 국민 기만”이라며 “핸드폰 포렌식부터 받으라”고 했다.)

Cho Kye-won, a DP spokesperson, said in a written briefing on the 4th, "The person who should offer explanations and receive a special counsel is lawmaker Han," and made these remarks. (조계원 민주당 대변인은 4일 서면브리핑을 내어 “해명하고 특검 받아야 할 사람은 한 의원”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

Spokesperson Cho said, "Lawmaker Han is not in a position to discuss the qualifications of nominee Kim as a public official," and added, "When it came to the suspicions of his family's expedient credentials and his brother-in-law's sexual misconduct and preferential treatment allegations that surfaced during his own confirmation hearing for Minister of Justice, he remained in cowardly silence." (조 대변인은 “한 의원은 김 후보자의 공직자 자격을 논할 위치에 있지 않다”며 “정작 본인의 법무부 장관 인사청문회 당시 불거진 가족의 편법 스펙 논란과 처남의 성범죄 비위·특혜 의혹에 관해서는 비겁한 침묵으로 일관했다”고 했다.)

He also said, "Lawmaker Han is someone who previously mocked the judicial order by hiding his phone password to evade the investigation net," and added, "Since technology now exists to perform forensics even on recent iPhones, I hope he boldly undergoes phone forensics." (또 “한 의원은 과거 수사망을 피하려 휴대전화 비밀번호를 숨긴 채 사법 질서를 우롱한 당사자”라며 “최근 아이폰도 포렌식이 가능한 기술이 나왔으니 당당하게 핸드폰 포렌식을 받길 바란다”고 말했다.)

Spokesperson Cho also said, "Lawmaker Han is overusing attacks based on the indictment and investigation records related to nominee Kim, but this is nothing more than a shallow attempt to distort a ruling that has already been concluded as acquittal," and "What lawmaker Han needs to clarify is how he obtained the indictment and investigation records." (조 대변인은 한 의원이 “김 후보자 관련 공소장과 수사기록으로 공격을 남발하고 있지만, 이미 무죄로 결론이 난 판결을 왜곡하려는 얄팍한 시도에 불과하다”며 “한 의원이 밝혀야 할 것은 어떻게 공소장과 수사기록을 입수했는지이다”라고도 했다.)

He added, "The people will no longer tolerate such black propaganda that reduces the National Assembly's constitutional authority to vet personnel appointments to a tool for personal media play in order to sustain political relevance." (이어 “정치적 존재감을 연명하기 위해 헌법이 부여한 국회의 인사 검증 권한을 개인의 언론 플레이 도구로 전락시키는 흑색선전을 국민은 더 이상 용납하지 않을 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Kim Chae-woon, Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Reducing South Korea-U.S. drills but continuing South Korea-U.S.-Japan drills: Why? (한·미 훈련은 축소하고…한·미·일 훈련은 계속하는 이유)
item.description:
The administration of U.S. President Donald Trump scaled down last month’s South Korea-U.S. combined exercise, “Ulchi Freedom Shield” (UFS), to engage with North Korea, while deciding to hold the South Korea-U.S.-Japan multidomain exercise “Freedom Edge” from the 7th to the 11th. In a statement released through the Korean Central News Agency on the 31st of last month, a North Korean Foreign Ministry spokesperson said of Freedom Edge: “At a grave juncture where the United States’ permanent hostile policy toward the DPRK is evolving into a more dangerous form, it is meaningless to expect any easing of tensions,” adding, “There is not the slightest change in our policy toward the United States to respond with the utmost toughness.” <<> The United States scaled down UFS, but despite North Korea’s backlash, why is it proceeding with Freedom Edge as planned? Because Freedom Edge is a “multidomain exercise” aimed at pressuring and containing China. <<> Multidomain exercises reflect the concept of “multidomain operations.” Multidomain operations signify that the battlefield has expanded beyond the familiar domains of land, sea, and air to include space, cyber, and electromagnetic domains. As multidomain operations extend into domains encompassing cyber and space, they expand beyond conflict zones to a global scale. <<> Multidomain operations are a concept and doctrine of the U.S. Army, developed to counter China’s rise and Russia’s threat. U.S. multidomain operations set the threat actors as “2+3” (Russia, China + Iran, North Korea, and extremist forces), but focus is placed on the “2” (Russia and China). Specifically, the core aim is to neutralize China’s “Anti-Access/Area Denial” (A2AD) strategy. <<> China’s anti-access/area denial strategy aims to deny U.S. aircraft carrier strike groups access to China’s vicinity (anti-access) and, even if the U.S. carrier groups approach China’s coastal waters, to force them to withdraw through protracted attrition warfare (area denial). The scope of China’s anti-access/area denial strategy is set within the first island chain (a line connecting Japan’s Kyushu–Okinawa–Taiwan–the Philippines) and the second island chain (a line connecting Japan’s Ogasawara Islands–Saipan–Guam–Indonesia). The island chain refers to virtual boundary lines linking key maritime routes and strongpoints within the region. The first and second island chains are China’s defensive lines to block the United States in the Pacific. <<> Within the first island chain, China uses short-range anti-ship missiles, diesel submarines, littoral combat ships, surface-to-ship cruise missiles, and fighter jets to block U.S. carrier approaches. In the second island chain, it denies U.S. carrier access using medium-range anti-ship missiles, conventional and nuclear attack submarines, and bombers. <<> U.S. multidomain operations mean mobilizing all means across multiple domains—space, cyber, and electronic warfare, as well as air, land, and sea—to neutralize the various missiles, air defense systems, and other weapons China has developed and deployed to block the approach of U.S. aircraft carriers. The U.S. Indo-Pacific Command, when announcing plans for the Freedom Edge exercise last September, stated that trilateral cooperation would “strengthen capabilities within the first island chain.” It did not hide that the Freedom Edge exercise is geared toward containing China. <<> Originally, the United States conceived of an “Air-Sea Battle” (ASB) concept as an operational approach to counter China. It envisioned U.S. Air Force and Navy conducting joint operations in the skies and seas of the Pacific to dismantle China’s anti-access/area denial system. But it is difficult for the U.S. Navy and Air Force to cross the Pacific and fight China’s naval and air forces in waters near China. Given China’s deployment of various anti-ship missiles, U.S. carrier strike groups face a high risk of being struck when approaching waters near China. <<> Mindful of this, the United States seeks to conduct multidomain operations by leveraging allies around China, such as South Korea and Japan. The Freedom Edge exercise, which the three countries—South Korea, the United States, and Japan—began on the 7th in international waters east and south of Jeju, stems from this background. <<> The site of the first Freedom Edge exercise in June 2024 was also international waters south of Jeju. This area is a chokepoint for China’s North Sea Fleet, based in Qingdao, Shandong Province, and its East Sea Fleet, based in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, as they exit into the Pacific. The first multidomain exercise of South Korea, the United States, and Japan was held at a strategically vital location blocking China’s advance into the Pacific. Since then, the Freedom Edge exercises held in November 2024 and September last year were also conducted in international waters near Jeju. Including this upcoming exercise, South Korea, the United States, and Japan have conducted or will conduct all four Freedom Edge multidomain exercises in the seas near Jeju. The Freedom Edge exercises have included maritime missile defense, air and air defense drills, anti-piracy training, anti-submarine operations, and cyber defense. <<> South Korea emphasizes that the purpose of the Freedom Edge exercise is to prepare for North Korea’s nuclear and missile threats. However, concerns are rising that, as this exercise is repeated, the South Korea-U.S. combined defense system could shift from a structure centered on defending the Korean Peninsula to a regional multidomain deterrence framework aimed at containing China. <<> Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (미국 도널드 트럼프 행정부가 북한과 대화하기 위해 지난달 한-미 연합연습인 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)를 축소하면서, 한·미·일 다영역 훈련인 ‘프리덤 에지’는 7~11일 하기로 했다. 북한 외무성 대변인은 지난달 31일 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 담화에서 프리덤 에지에 대해 “미국의 항구적인 대조선 적대시 정책이 보다 위험한 형태로 진화되고 있는 엄중한 정세 국면에서 그 어떤 긴장 완화를 기대하는 것은 무의미하다”며 “최강경으로 대응하려는 우리의 대미 정책에는 추호의 변화도 없다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Innovation Party on 'Review of Hormuz Deployment'... "A Line That Must Not Be Crossed" Progressive Party "Extremely Dangerous" (‘호르무즈 파병 검토’에…혁신당 “넘어선 안 될 선” 진보당 “위험천만”)
item.description:
As the presidential office said on the 4th regarding the 'deployment to the Strait of Hormuz' that "it is at the review stage, but nothing has been decided," the Fatherland Innovation Party and the Progressive Party both expressed opposition to the deployment. The Democratic Party of Korea said, "This is not yet a matter to state a position on." (청와대가 4일 ‘호르무즈해협 파병’에 대해 “검토 단계에 있지만, 결정된 바 없다”고 밝힌 가운데, 조국혁신당과 진보당은 일제히 파병 반대 입장을 밝혔다. 더불어민주당은 “아직 입장을 밝힐 사안이 아니”라고 했다.)

Kim Jun-hyung, the Innovation Party's floor leader, said in a comment that day, "Why should the Republic of Korea review a 'deployment' for an illegal war of aggression? The moment we place our naval vessels in the middle of a military conflict, we could instead expose the people and soldiers we must protect to the dangers of war," adding, "'Deployment' is a line the government must absolutely never cross." ( 김준형 혁신당 원내대표는 이날 논평을 내어 “왜 불법적인 침략 전쟁에 대한민국이 ‘파병’을 검토해야 하는가. 대한민국 군함을 군사적 충돌의 한복판에 세우는 순간, 우리는 보호해야 할 국민과 장병을 오히려 전쟁의 위험에 노출시킬 수 있다”며 “‘파병’은 정부가 절대로 넘어서는 안 될 선”이라고 했다. )

Floor leader Kim said, "Even the Yoon Suk-yeol administration did not openly deploy troops to the Ukraine war," and "It is absurd that talk of reviewing a 'deployment' to help an illegal aggressor nation is emerging from the Lee Jae-myung administration, which claims to be a government of popular sovereignty." He added, "They should not hide behind the phrase 'nothing has been decided.' The repeated pattern of deliberately leaking information first and then denying it when criticism pours in—this double play must stop immediately." ( 김 원내대표는 “윤석열 정부조차 우크라이나 전쟁에 대놓고 파병하지는 않았다”며 “국민주권정부를 자임하는 이재명 정부에서 불법 침략국가를 돕는 ‘파병’을 검토한다는 말이 나오는 자체가 어불성설”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “‘결정된 바 없다’라는 말 뒤에 숨지 말아야 한다. 최근 반복되어온 패턴인, 먼저 의도적으로 흘리고 비판이 쏟아지면 부인하는 이중플레이는 즉각 중단하라”고 덧붙였다. )

Cho Kuk, head of the Fatherland Innovation Party's Innovation Policy Research Institute, posted on Facebook that day, citing Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Constitution of the Republic of Korea, stating that "the Republic of Korea renounces aggressive wars." ( 조국 조국혁신 혁신정책연구원장은 이날 페이스북에 대한민국 헌법 제5조 제1항을 인용해 “대한민국은 침략적 전쟁을 부인한다”는 글을 올렸다.)

Kim Jong-hoon, leader of the Progressive Party, also said in a comment, "The Hormuz deployment is not something to be brushed aside with the line 'nothing has been decided,'" and "President Lee Jae-myung must answer directly. He must clearly declare that we will not deploy to Hormuz." Representative Kim said, "Who on earth is reviewing and pushing for such an extremely dangerous deployment? The circumstances and those responsible must be revealed." ( 김종훈 진보당 대표도 논평에서 “호르무즈 파병은 ‘결정된 바 없다’ 선 긋기로 넘어갈 일이 아니”라며 “이재명 대통령이 직접 답해야 한다. 호르무즈에 파병하지 않겠다고 분명히 선언해야 한다”고 했다. 김 대표는 “도대체 누가 이런 위험천만한 파병을 검토하고 추진하고 있는가. 그 경위와 책임자를 밝혀야 한다”고 했다. )

The Democratic Party of Korea has not issued an official position. Lee Ju-hui, the party's deputy spokesperson for communication, met with reporters that day and said, "Since the relevant standing committee is the National Defense Committee, it seems we need to assess the situation or hold discussions within the committee," adding, "There is no particular matter to decide or confirm as a party position." A key official on the National Defense Committee told The Hankyoreh, "It appears the government is still in the stage of reviewing various scenarios," and "It is difficult for the committee to set a position first when the government's stance has not been finalized." ( 더불어민주당은 공식 입장을 내지 않고 있다. 이주희 원내대변인은 이날 취재진을 만나 “주무 상임위가 국방위원회인 만큼 국방위 내에서 상황 파악이나 논의를 해야 할 것 같다”며 “특별히 당내 입장을 정하거나 확인할 사안이 없다”고 했다. 국방위 핵심 관계자는 한겨레에 “아직 정부가 여러 시나리오를 검토하는 단계인 것 같다”며 “정부 입장이 정리되지 않은 상황에서 국방위가 먼저 입장을 정하기는 어렵다”고 했다.)

However, Lee Ki-heon, a Democratic Party lawmaker on the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, stated on Facebook, "If a request for parliamentary consent to a deployment comes, I will not agree to the Hormuz deployment in order to protect national interests and constitutional values." The lawmaker said, "The presidential office says 'nothing has been decided,' but the very fact that deployment options for our military's reconnaissance assets or logistics support are being floated through the media is deeply concerning," adding, "I express deep regret over (U.S. President Donald Trump's) attitude of using allies as a tool of pressure, and under no pretext can our military's deployment to the Strait of Hormuz be tolerated." The lawmaker said, "Even if it is non-combat forces, its essence is clearly 'participation in war,'" and "We cannot push our people and military into a war with no end in sight that the U.S. started and has sunk into a quagmire." ( 다만 국회 외교통일위원회 소속 이기헌 민주당 의원은 페이스북에 “국회에 파병 동의 요청이 오면 국익과 헌법 가치를 수호하기 위해, 호르무즈 파병에 동의하지 않을 것”이라는 입장을 밝혔다. 이 의원은 “청와대는 ‘결정된 바 없다’고 밝혔지만, 우리 군의 정찰자산이나 군수지원 등의 파병 카드가 언론을 통해 거론되는 것 자체만으로도 심히 우려스럽다”며 “(미국 도널드 트럼프 대통령이) 동맹을 압박의 도구로 삼는 태도에 깊은 유감을 표하며, 어떠한 명목으로도 우리 군의 호르무즈 해협 파병은 용납할 수 없다”고 했다. 이 의원은 “비전투병 전력이라 한들, 그 본질은 명백한 ‘전쟁 참여’”라며 “미국이 일으키고 수렁에 빠진 기약 없는 전쟁에 우리 국민과 군을 내몰 수는 없다”고 했다. )

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hong Jun-pyo: "How Dare Han Dong-hoon Slander Jang Dong-hyuk... A Traitor to Conservatism" (홍준표 “한동훈, 무슨 염치로 장동혁 비방하나…보수의 배신자가”)
item.description:
Hong Jun-pyo, former mayor of Daegu, criticized independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon for calling People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk a "strategic asset of the Democratic Party," saying, "How dare he slander Representative Jang, who is fighting well?" (자신과의 연대에 선을 그은 장동혁 국민의힘 대표를 ‘민주당의 전략자산’이라고 비판한 한동훈 무소속 의원에 대해 홍준표 전 대구시장이 “무슨 염치로 잘 싸우고 있는 장 대표를 비방하느냐”고 지적했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 4th, the former mayor said, "Is that any way for a shameless traitor to conservatism—who betrayed the benefactor who cared for him for 20 years and kowtowed to the Lee Jae-myung regime, handing over the government—to talk?" (홍 전 시장은 4일 페이스북에서 “20년 자기를 돌봐준 은인을 배신하고 이재명 정권에 부화뇌동하여 정권을 헌납한 파렴치한 보수의 배신자가 그게 할 말이냐”며 이같이 말했다.)

Regarding Han, Hong claimed, "Han Dong-hoon is nothing but a phantom created by Yoon Suk-yeol, and in all his fights so far, he has never won once." He added, "Even with some 200 prosecutors at his disposal, he couldn't arrest Lee Jae-myung (then leader of the Democratic Party) after shaking him down for two years, and even in the early days of the (Yoon Suk-yeol) administration when the ruling camp was in good shape, he suffered a crushing defeat in the general election." (홍 전 시장은 한 의원에 대해 “한동훈은 윤석열이 만들어준 허상에 불과하고 그동안 싸워서 한 번도 이긴 일이 없다”고 주장했다. 이어 “검사 200여명(을) 데리고 이재명 (당시 더불어민주당) 대표를 2년 동안 탈탈 털어도 구속시키지 못했고 (윤석열) 정권 초기 여권이 그 좋던 시절에도 총선에서 참패했다”고 꼬집었다.)

Earlier, on the 2nd, Representative Jang said in an interview with the Munhwa Ilbo that was published, "There's room for alliance or merger with any force that agrees with conservative values," but firmly stated, "As long as I am the leader, I do not believe we should align or work together with independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon." (앞서 장 대표는 지난 2일 공개된 문화일보와의 인터뷰에서 “보수의 가치에 동의하는 모든 세력과 연대든 합당이든 가능성이 열려 있다”면서도 “내가 대표로 있는 한 한동훈 무소속 의원과 연대하거나 함께 가야 한다고 생각지 않는다”고 못 박은 바 있다.)

In response, Han posted on Facebook the same day, saying, "When I met Representative Jang Dong-hyuk just before I stepped down as party leader due to the impeachment of President Yoon Suk-yeol, his last words to me were, 'I will protect you, Leader, to the end.'" He added, "Even if one's position can change according to one's political interests, it is hard to understand the blind hatred shown in today's Munhwa Ilbo interview." He went on to say, "At a time when we should be pooling our strength to stop the rampage of Lee Jae-myung's Democratic Party regime, seeing him seriously distort facts with such personal hostility and hatred to provoke internal strife, division, and chaos within the conservative camp—it makes me think he really is a 'strategic asset of the Democratic Party.'" (그러자 한 의원은 같은날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “윤석열 대통령 탄핵으로 당대표에서 물러나기 직전 저를 만났을 때 장동혁 대표가 마지막으로 한 말은 ‘제가 대표님을 끝까지 지키겠습니다’였다”며 “아무리 자기 정치적 이익에 따라 입장이 변할 수 있다 하더라도 오늘 문화일보 인터뷰에서 보이는 맹목적 증오심을 이해하기는 어렵다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “이재명 민주당 정권의 폭주를 막기 위해 힘을 모아야 할 지금도 이렇게 개인적인 적개심과 증오로 팩트를 심각하게 왜곡해서 보수 내부싸움과 분열, 혼란을 유도하는 것을 보니 괜히 ‘민주당의 전략자산’이라는 게 아닌 것 같다”고 덧붙였다.)

Meanwhile, Hong, who left the PPP after losing in the party's presidential primary in April of last year, has since continuously raised criticism against former President Yoon Suk-yeol, Han, and the PPP. On the 23rd of last month, reacting to the acquittal of former Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Woong-rae in his second trial, he criticized Han, who had said, "Let's listen to the (related) recording file," calling it "an ignorant and uneducated argument." Previously, Hong had also taken a jab at Han, calling him not the "best sword of Joseon" but the "best gum of Joseon." (한편, 지난해 4월 국민의힘 대선 경선에서 탈락한 뒤 탈당한 홍 전 시장은 이후 윤석열 전 대통령과 한 의원, 국민의힘에 대한 비판을 지속적으로 제기해왔다. 지난달 23일에는 노웅래 전 민주당 의원의 2심 무죄 선고에 반발하며 “(혐의 관련) 녹음파일을 들어보자”는 한 의원을 향해 “무식하고 무지한 주장”이라고 비판했다. 앞서 홍 전 시장은 한 의원을 두고 “‘조선제일검’이 아니라 ‘조선제일껌’”이라고 꼬집기도 했다.)

Reporter Lee Yu-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Launches All-Out Offensive to Unseat Kim Seung-won and Yong Hye-in... "Withdraw Nominations by the Weekend" (국힘 ‘김승원·용혜인’ 낙마 총공세…“주말까지 지명 철회하라”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) launched an all-out offensive on the 4th to unseat Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, who is embroiled in suspicions of involvement in lobbying for COVID-19 treatments, and Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, who faces criticism over "holding dual roles as minister and proportional representative." (국민의힘은 4일 ‘코로나19 치료제 로비 연루 의혹’에 휩싸인 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자와 ‘장관·비례대표직 겸직’ 비판을 받는 용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자를 겨냥한 낙마 총공세에 나섰다.)

Floor leader Jang Dong-hyuk said in a Facebook post that day, "Nominee Kim Seung-won doesn't even deserve to go to a confirmation hearing. He should either resign immediately, or President Lee Jae-myung should withdraw his nomination." Jang cited one by one the suspicions of involvement in COVID-19 treatment lobbying and past drunk driving records, saying, "President Lee Jae-myung, do you believe Kim Seung-won will save you? Kim Seung-won will become the nuclear bomb that brings down the Lee Jae-myung administration." (장동혁 대표는 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “김승원 후보자, 청문회까지 갈 자격도 없다. 즉각 본인이 사퇴하든지, 이재명 대통령이 지명을 철회해야 한다”고 했다. 장 대표는 코로나19 치료제 로비 연루 의혹과 과거 음주운전 이력 등을 하나씩 거론하며 “이재명 대통령, 김승원이 구해줄 거라고 믿는가. 김승원이 이재명 정권을 무너뜨리는 핵폭탄이 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Policy chief Chung Joum-sik said at the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "Nominee Kim, the minister in charge of the president's (Lee's) dismissal of indictments, is not qualified to undergo a confirmation hearing. The nomination should be withdrawn immediately." He stressed, "The COVID-19 new drug bribery case is escalating, but it is absurd in itself that someone who received a suspended indictment becomes the Minister of Justice. The fact that a person given a suspended indictment for a bribery-related case becomes the head of the ministry under the prosecution service in charge of indictments is a massive conflict of interest." (정점식 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 원내대책회의에서 “(이 대통령) 공소취소 담당 장관 김 후보자는 청문회를 받을 자격이 없다”며 “바로 지명 철회해야 한다”고 했다. 그는 “코로나19 신약 뇌물 사건이 점입가경인데 기소유예자가 법무부 장관이 된다는 것 자체가 어불성설”이라며 “뇌물 관련 사건의 기소유예자가 기소를 담당하는 공소청 소관 부처의 장관이 된다는 것 자체가 엄청난 이해충돌”이라고 강조했다.)

Vice policy chief Kim Mi-ae released photos of nominee Yong Hye-in taking part in the "No Work, Yes Money" movement in 2017 and 2019, saying, "Some people work hard, sweat, and pay taxes, but we cannot entrust a state minister position to a politician who refuses responsibility and shouts for money without working. This isn't youth politics—it's privilege politics, and it's not youth appointment—it's personnel padding." (김미애 원내정책수석부대표는 용혜인 후보자가 2017년과 2019년 ‘노 워크 예스 머니(No Work, Yes Money) 운동’을 하던 사진을 공개하며 “누군가는 땀 흘려 일하고 세금을 내는데, 책임은 지지 않은 채 일하지 않아도 돈을 달라고 외치는 정치인에게 대한민국 국무위원을 맡길 수 없다”며 “청년 정치가 아니라 특권 정치고, 청년 인사가 아니라 인사 분식”이라고 했다.)

Policy committee chairperson Yim Yea-ja said at the meeting that day, "The public's judgment on the two nominees is already done. They are the ultimate shameless ones who have even forgotten shame. President Lee, by this weekend, firmly withdraw your nominations for these two, as the people command." (임이자 정책위의장은 이날 회의에서 “두 후보자에 대한 국민의 평가는 이미 끝났다. 부끄러움조차 잊은 후안무치 끝판왕”이라며 “이 대통령은 이번 주말까지 국민의 명령대로 두 사람에 대한 지명을 단호히 철회하라”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Park Jung-hoon also released on Facebook that day a public interest whistleblower statement filed with the Seoul Western District Court by a consultant who worked at the company of broker Yang (last name), who had asked nominee Kim for approval of clinical trials, regarding Kang (last name), the founder of Genencell, who had pursued the development of a COVID-19 treatment with Yang. In the statement, the consultant claimed, "During the execution of the lobbying, there were circumstances where (Kang) deposited 5 million won to Rep. Kim Seung-won's side, but the transaction failed due to exceeding the limit. This is a clear expression of intent and commencement of execution to actually pay a quid pro quo, so its nature as consideration must be acknowledged." (박정훈 의원은 이날 페이스북에 김 후보자에게 임상시험 승인을 부탁한 브로커 양아무개씨 회사에서 재직한 컨설턴트가 양씨와 코로나19 치료제 개발을 추진하던 제넨셀 창업주 강아무개씨에 대해 서울서부지법에 낸 공익신고자 의견서를 공개하기도 했다. 해당 컨설턴트는 의견서에서 “로비의 실행 과정에서 (강씨가) 김승원 의원 측으로 500만원을 입금했으나, 한도 초과로 인해 불발된 정황이 존재한다”며 “이는 대가를 실질적으로 지급하고자 했던 명백한 의사 표시이자 실행의 착수이므로 그 대가성을 반드시 인정해야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Jang Na-rae, staff reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Chung Jeom-sik: "Review of Hormuz Deployment Should Not Be About Gauging Opposition Views; Must Clearly Explain Korea-U.S. Relations" (정점식 “호르무즈 파병 검토, 야당 간 보지 말고 한·미 관계 설명해야”)
item.description:
People Power Party on the 4th, regarding the government's review of deployment to the Strait of Hormuz, urged that "Our government, having already lost the trust of the United States and then belatedly starting to review deployment, has clearly missed the timing," and called for transparently disclosing the current state of the Korea-U.S. alliance to the National Assembly. (국민의힘은 4일 정부의 호르무즈 해협 파병 검토와 관련해 “우리 정부가 이미 미국의 신뢰를 잃어버리고 나서 뒤늦게 파병 검토에 착수한 것은 명백한 실기”라며 한-미 동맹 현황을 국회에 투명하게 공개하라고 촉구했다.)

Floor leader Chung Jeom-sik said on Facebook the same day, "The presidential office says 'it is in the review stage and nothing has been decided,' but isn't that just gauging public opinion and the opposition's reaction regarding deployment?" adding, "Deployment requires the consent of the National Assembly. Sending our troops overseas is not a decision to be made lightly and requires careful review." He further stressed, "The problem is that the Lee Jae-myung administration is vacillating over the Hormuz deployment issue, losing the initiative and appearing to be dragged along by U.S. pressure. Instead of gauging the opposition's views, the government should come before the National Assembly and transparently disclose what the current situation is regarding the Strait of Hormuz and Korea-U.S. relations." (정점식 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “청와대는 ‘(호르무즈 해협 파병이) 검토 단계에 있으며 정해진 것은 없다’라고 말하는데, 파병에 대한 여론과 야당의 반응을 간 보기 하는 것 아닌가”라며 “파병에는 국회의 동의가 필수적이다. 우리 군 장병을 해외에 보내는 것은 쉽게 결정할 사안이 아니며, 신중한 검토가 필요하다”고 했다. 이어 “문제는 이재명 정부가 호르무즈 해협 파병 이슈에 우왕좌왕하다가 주도권을 잃어버리고 미국의 압박에 끌려가는 모양새라는 것”이라며 “정부는 야당을 상대로 간 보기 할 것이 아니라, 국회에 나와서 지금 호르무즈 해협과 한미 관계의 상황이 어떠한가를 투명하게 공개해야 한다”고 강조했다.)

Floor leader Chung wrote, "Initially, the government and the ruling party were negative about deploying to the Strait of Hormuz. However, recently President Trump has repeatedly stated that the Republic of Korea refused his requests to help with the Iran issue, and even said 'I will remember this,' openly expressing dissatisfaction. Now, between Korea and the U.S., there are not only the Hormuz deployment issue but also numerous pending matters that signal an unusual chill in the Korea-U.S. alliance, including the unilateral reduction of joint Korea-U.S. military exercises, the Coupang incident, the so-called 'gag law' amendment to the Information and Communications Network Act, and delays in implementing investments in the U.S." (정 원내대표는 “당초 정부·여당은 호르무즈 해협 파병에 부정적이었다. 그러나 최근 트럼프 대통령은 연이어 대한민국이 이란 문제를 도와달라는 요청을 거절했다고 밝히면서 ‘이 일은 기억해 두겠다’고까지 하며 노골적인 불만을 드러냈다”며 “지금 한-미 양국 간에는 호르무즈 해협 파병뿐 아니라, 일방적인 한-미 연합훈련 축소, 쿠팡 사태, ‘입틀막법’ 정보통신망법, 대미 투자 이행 지연 등 한-미동맹 이상기류를 느끼게 하는 여러 현안이 산적해 있다”고 적었다.)

He added, "This morning, our party requested an urgent inquiry at the National Assembly's Defense Committee level. We urge the government to transparently explain to the National Assembly the background and practical benefits of reviewing the Hormuz deployment." (그러면서 “오늘 아침, 우리 당은 국회 국방위 차원에서 긴급 현안질의를 요구했다”며 “정부는 호르무즈 해협 파병 검토의 배경과 실익을 국회에 투명하게 설명할 것을 촉구한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Jang Na-rae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)
